0c016bedf47e2f01dba2340990811b8abb8ddbc9.caption: Do example: an unchecked checkbox with a three-line lorem ipsum label. A purple dashed arrow dimension below spans from the checkbox to the right end of the text and is labelled "max. 544px", the maximum width of the text container (16px*34em = 544px) for good readability.

12b38bf774078ac64a8b1f456942bd7496d51c86.caption: Anatomy of the checkbox with two numbered callouts. Callout 1 points at the checkbox itself, shown checked with an orange check mark in a dark square box. Callout 2 points at the checkbox label "Checkbox Label" to the right of the box, the copy that describes the item you want to select.

24ba41b4141bdf72acc3e49c6ef1d670547cba3b.caption: Horizontal checkbox group with the legend "Checkbox Group Legend" and three "Checkbox Label" checkboxes in one row: unchecked, checked (orange check mark) and unchecked. Suited for up to 3 checkboxes with short copy.

32dac39282b3d4a86782d1c794088cc6cae16617.caption: Three checkbox states side by side, each with the label "Checkbox Label" and a numbered callout. Callout 1 points at the unchecked checkbox, an empty square box. Callout 2 points at the checked checkbox with an orange check mark; multiple checkboxes can be activated at the same time. Callout 3 points at the indeterminate checkbox with an orange dash, used when the underlying checkbox group has a mix of checked and unchecked boxes.

3988706d5595c26ea94db7a2f3397f4994fa5338.caption: Vertical checkbox group example for content and assets, with the legend "Checkbox Group Legend", a lorem ipsum hint and five "Checkbox Label" checkboxes in a column: the first two unchecked, the third and fourth checked (orange check marks) and the fifth unchecked.

5dcfd980f77793b6203115b87919a9c3f5809ded.caption: Overflow behaviour of a checkbox with a long lorem ipsum label wrapping onto three lines. 5f950c87643dad3fe8c25916b044e5426e252138.caption: Do example: use checkboxes when multiple items can be selected. A vertical checkbox group with the legend "Checkbox Group Legend", a lorem ipsum hint and four checkboxes labelled "Checkbox Label"; the first is unchecked and the other three are checked with orange check marks.

6544664407cd859a82aafaf02c8c303b0f021712.caption: Horizontal checkbox group with the legend "Checkbox Group Legend" and a lorem ipsum hint, arranged in three columns and three rows of nine checkboxes labelled "Checkbox Label". 7d742e7733823c5d82e3f136f47263007ceeabf7.caption: Invalid, unchecked checkbox with a long multi-line lorem ipsum label and a red border around the box. 84c8f5aca5125bb54bec1bd80605eac74983756b.caption: Don't example: an unchecked checkbox next to a three-line lorem ipsum label, with the checkbox vertically centred against the text block instead of aligned to the top. Do not align the text to the center.

9820af5bb26b4c89a92a6e1fb5f90f63e6f00722.caption: Two filter examples using checkboxes. Left, desktop ("Example left: Original STIHL® Parts (Desktop)"): a field labelled "Select" with the opened dropdown "Category (3)" and a chevron up, listing seven checkboxes: "Air filters" (checked), "Carrying rings", "Blow tubes", "Grass hear and and shrubs hear blades" (checked), "Lawn mower blades", "Chainsprocktet blades" and "Filter covers" (checked). ac7847d73988fab05ccac862a7a0583f0fc118ae.caption: Click area of a checkbox: in a vertical group with the legend "Checkbox Group Legend" and a lorem ipsum hint, the first unchecked "Checkbox Label" is hovered by a pointer cursor over its label text. The box and the label are highlighted together in light orange, showing that the label is clickable and triggers the activation. The three checkboxes below are checked.

acdfeb1b9acadd93e3fcc9219903015622efb55a.caption: Don't example: an unchecked checkbox with a two-line lorem ipsum label stretched across a wide container. A purple dashed arrow dimension below spans the whole width and is labelled "greater than 544px". Do not exceed 544px, even when the module or grid is wider.

ba4524d9aa50a1d925df10ee4ea2f72f0c7a4568.caption: Do example: a vertical checkbox group with the legend "Which of the following characteristics do you believe contribute significantly to the creation of your garden?" and the hint "Select all that apply". Five options use uniform formatting, each starting with a bold term followed by a colon and a description: "Plant Diversity:", "Design and Layout:", "Functional Areas:" (checked), "Water Features:" (checked) and "Wildlife Attraction:". Uniform labels let users scan a long list easily. A green "Do" badge marks it as correct.

ca9fdb8dbd93bf35b90d86b7548c60902b20920a.caption: Vertical checkbox group with the legend "Product name" and an info button (a filled circle with an "i", hovered by a pointer cursor) next to it. A large white popover with a downward arrow above the info button reads "You will usually find the Product name in the location shown in the illustrations" and contains two line drawings of a STIHL engine unit and a battery trimmer with "XXXXXXXXX" placeholder callouts, as supplementary, non-critical help.

d083ca9554f6a2777ddfe7a416411aff5efceeb8.caption: Single checkbox: one unchecked checkbox in default state with a three-line lorem ipsum label, the box aligned with the first line of text. Typical uses are accepting a privacy policy, newsletter subscription and remembering login credentials.

e2129a926a38df8d0b99ad409a8983ef7e35c499.caption: Do example: use radio buttons when only one item can be selected. A vertical radio group with the legend "Radio Group Legend", a lorem ipsum hint and four options labelled "Radio Label"; the first is selected (orange filled dot) and the other three are unselected.

e37aee0e0ab2ef6bedba3690c8b7c9afb5c7eb6d.caption: Anatomy of the vertical checkbox group with five numbered callouts. Callout 1 points at the legend "Checkbox Group Legend". Callout 2 points at the hint, a lorem ipsum text below the legend. Callout 3 points at the optional info button, an info icon right of the legend. Callout 4 points at the system feedback, a red warning icon with "System Feedback Message". Callout 5 points at a checkbox with its "Checkbox Label"; five unchecked checkboxes are listed below.

Default: a purple dashed frame contains a vertical group with "Checkbox Group Legend", a lorem ipsum hint and five unchecked "Checkbox Label" checkboxes, and a horizontal group with the same legend and hint and three unchecked "Checkbox Label" checkboxes in one row. Below, labelled "invalid true", the same two groups show a red warning icon with "System Feedback Message" between hint and checkboxes, and all checkbox borders are red.

e6e8886f4f77aad62db648b3c04fd6543cfaf539.caption: Invalid vertical checkbox group with the legend "Checkbox Group Legend" and a hint of lorem ipsum text. Below the hint is the group error message "Choose at least 1 item in the list" with a red warning icon, aligned with the checkboxes. Under it are three unchecked checkboxes labelled "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing".

e8d2f5461ce3bf9d2c71148c6e846b66f2a1c3e2.caption: Overview matrix of the Checkbox with the label "Checkbox Label". Columns are the states "default", "hover/pressed" (grey filled box), "focus" (thick dark outline) and "disabled" (greyed out); rows are "checked false /indeterminate false" (empty box), "checked true" (orange check mark) and "indeterminate true" (orange dash), plus "invalid true" with "checked false" and "checked true", which have a red border and the red error message "System Feedback Message" with an alert icon below the label. Disabled exists only for unchecked and checked, and the rows are enclosed by a purple dashed frame. Below, the property "Show Label" is "true" (box with label) or "false" (box only) for unchecked, checked and indeterminate, and "Show System Feedback" is "true" (invalid box with message) or "false" (invalid box with label only).

ee4c61eb543e79228f5493b0d73da0b14647c737.caption: Do example: an unchecked checkbox next to a three-line lorem ipsum label, with the checkbox aligned to the top, level with the first line of the text. Align the checkbox and text to the top.

f007427cf3abdaed69ae0760fbbacce2154a471b.caption: Vertical checkbox group for longer copy, with the legend "Checkbox Group Legend", a lorem ipsum hint and three stacked checkboxes labelled "Checkbox Label lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur": unchecked, checked (orange check mark) and unchecked.

f2bc938f0105fb02f0c57ca91e0ce4b864faf7cb.caption: Click area of the checkbox shown with two examples.
